title: Integrated Pipeline and Replicability Study of Network-based Pivoting Detection
affiliations: Masaryk University and Masaryk University

detail.title: Integrated Pipeline and Replicability Study of Network-based Pivoting Detection
detail.abstract: Pivoting is a technique commonly employed by advanced adversaries to perform lateral movement within a network. In this process, an attacker leverages an intermediary host to relay commands to otherwise inaccessible systems. In this work, we survey the current state-of-the-art lateral movement detection techniques, identify approaches best suited for detecting pivoting behavior, and develop an automated pipeline for pivoting detection. Specifically, we focus on methods analyzing network traffic, not system logs, since we are looking for network-wide solution. The contributions of this paper are two-fold. First, we present the results of a replicability study, in which we find that only a few proposed approaches have a usable, publicly available implementation, but their results are promising. Second, we design and implement an end-to-end pivoting detection pipeline, in which we process various dataset or live network traffic and integrate existing detection methods to evaluate their performance and analyze their results in depth. By integrating multiple pivoting detection algorithms, heuristics, and filters, we make a significant step towards real-world use of pivoting detection and allow for the comparison of existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了横向移动检测技术现状，识别了最适合检测pivoting行为的方法，并开发了一个自动化的pivoting检测管道，重点关注网络流量分析方法。
AI.research_question: 如何有效检测网络攻击中的pivoting（横向移动）行为？哪些现有检测方法最适合检测pivoting？如何构建一个端到端的pivoting检测管道？
AI.motivation: pivoting是高级攻击者常用的横向移动技术，攻击者通过中间主机中继命令访问原本无法访问的系统。当前缺乏对pivoting检测技术的系统评估和可用的公开实现，需要开发网络范围的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络攻击检测理论、横向移动检测技术、网络流量分析理论、pivoting行为模式识别理论
AI.method: 1. 可复制性研究：评估现有检测方法的可用公开实现；2. 端到端pivoting检测管道设计：处理数据集或实时网络流量，集成现有检测方法；3. 性能评估：整合多种pivoting检测算法、启发式方法和过滤器
AI.findings: 1. 可复制性研究发现只有少数方法有可用的公开实现，但结果有希望；2. 通过集成多种检测方法，向实际应用迈出重要一步；3. 允许对现有方法进行比较分析
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统梳理了pivoting检测技术的现状；2. 建立了pivoting检测方法的评估框架；3. 提出了网络流量分析为主的检测理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了端到端的pivoting检测自动化管道；2. 提供了现有检测方法的性能比较；3. 整合了多种算法和启发式方法，促进实际应用；4. 为网络安全实践提供了可操作的检测工具

title: POLAND: A Hybrid Framework for Automated Programming Language Detection
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Padua, affiliation not provided to SSRN, LTIMindtree Limited, LTIMindtree Limited, LTIMindtree Limited, University of Padua, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Padua

detail.title: POLAND: A Hybrid Framework for Automated Programming Language Detection
detail.abstract: Automatic Programming Language Identification (PLI) tools help in software development tasks such as code analysis, software maintenance, and vulnerability detection. Existing PLI methods rely on file extensions, grammar analysis, and pattern matching to identify the language. Ultimately results with low accuracy and adaptability issues. In addition, existing PLI methods struggle with syntax issues due to shared keywords or tokens across different programming languages, resulting in frequent mis-identification of the language. To address these significant challenges, we have developed a hybrid framework named PrOgram LANguage Detection (POLAND). POLAND integrates Natural Language Processing (NLP), Deep Learning, and Machine Learning (ML) techniques. By combining three classification techniques as: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Random Forest (RF), and Multinomial Naive Bayes (MNB) models, POLAND filters commonalities and classifies programming languages based on the maximum preference. POLAND utilizes both synthesized and publicly available datasets for 36 languages and achieves 97% accuracy across all detected languages within a comparable time frame of 60 seconds.

AI.tldr: POLAND是一个混合框架，结合NLP、深度学习和机器学习技术，通过CNN、随机森林和朴素贝叶斯三种分类器，实现了97%准确率的编程语言识别，解决了现有方法准确率低和语法混淆问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个高准确率、适应性强的自动编程语言识别框架，以解决现有方法在语法混淆、准确率低和适应性差的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有编程语言识别方法依赖文件扩展名、语法分析和模式匹配，准确率低且适应性差，同时由于不同编程语言共享关键词或标记，导致语法混淆和频繁误识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自然语言处理（NLP）、深度学习、机器学习（ML）理论，以及集成学习思想，结合多种分类器提高识别准确率。
AI.method: 开发POLAND混合框架，集成卷积神经网络（CNN）、随机森林（RF）和多项式朴素贝叶斯（MNB）三种分类技术，通过过滤共性和基于最大偏好分类，使用合成和公开数据集覆盖36种编程语言。
AI.findings: POLAND在所有检测的编程语言上达到97%的准确率，在60秒的可比较时间范围内完成识别，显著优于现有方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个混合NLP、深度学习和机器学习的编程语言识别理论框架，展示了多分类器集成在解决语法混淆问题上的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的POLAND工具，为代码分析、软件维护和漏洞检测等软件开发任务提供高准确率的语言识别支持，解决了现有工具的准确率和适应性限制。

title: Cybersecurity in Public Administration: Selecting a Theoretical Framework and Analyzing International Literature

detail.title: Cybersecurity in Public Administration: Selecting a Theoretical Framework and Analyzing International Literature
detail.abstract: The acceleration of digital transformation in the public sector has increased dependence on digital services and exposed governments to increasingly complex and interconnected technological environments, where cybersecurity failures directly compromise the continuity of public services and institutional trust. In this context, this article critically analyzes the international scientific production on cybersecurity in public administration between 2018 and 2025, arguing that the field’s main limitation is not the absence of norms, policies, or frameworks, but the persistent inability to explain how these guidelines translate into operational effectiveness. The research adopts the Knowledge Development Process Constructivist (ProKnow-C) to build a bibliographic portfolio of 33 articles indexed in the Scopus and Web of Science databases, analyzed through bibliometric techniques and content analysis. The results reveal growth in the field, but with high intellectual fragmentation and a predominance of institutional approaches disconnected from technical-operational capabilities and performance metrics. In response to this explanatory gap, the article reframes Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) not as an isolated emerging technology, but as an integrative sociotechnical framework for public sector cybersecurity. The main contribution lies in proposing an integrative sociotechnical framework that links governance, technological modernization, and measurable public outcomes, providing an analytical basis for evaluating service continuity, availability, and incident reduction in digital government contexts.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判性分析了2018-2025年公共行政网络安全领域的国际科学研究，发现该领域主要局限不在于缺乏规范政策，而在于无法解释这些指南如何转化为操作有效性。研究提出将零信任网络访问（ZTNA）重构为公共部门网络安全的整合性社会技术框架。
AI.research_question: 公共行政网络安全领域的主要局限是什么？如何解释网络安全指南向操作有效性的转化？
AI.motivation: 公共部门数字化转型加速增加了对数字服务的依赖，网络安全故障直接影响公共服务连续性和机构信任。当前网络安全领域存在解释性差距，无法说明规范政策如何转化为实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识发展过程建构主义（ProKnow-C）方法论，整合性社会技术框架理论，零信任网络访问（ZTNA）理论重构
AI.method: 采用ProKnow-C方法构建包含33篇Scopus和Web of Science数据库文章的文献组合，通过文献计量技术和内容分析进行分析
AI.findings: 该领域在研究数量上有所增长，但存在高度知识碎片化，且以脱离技术操作能力和绩效指标的机构方法为主导。揭示了网络安全指南向操作有效性转化的解释性差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 将零信任网络访问（ZTNA）重构为整合性社会技术框架而非孤立新兴技术，提出了连接治理、技术现代化和可衡量公共成果的分析框架，为评估数字政府环境中的服务连续性、可用性和事件减少提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共部门网络安全提供了整合性社会技术框架，帮助连接治理、技术现代化和可衡量的公共成果，为评估服务连续性、可用性和事件减少提供分析基础。

title: Information transparency and pricing competition in urban air mobility platforms
affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Dongbei University of Finance and Economics and Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

detail.title: Information transparency and pricing competition in urban air mobility platforms
detail.abstract: Urban Air Mobility (UAM)  offering a promising alternative to congested ground transport. UAM platforms require information sharing among service providers for operational coordination, yet the competitive implications of such transparency on pricing and welfare remain unclear. This paper develops a game-theoretic model to analyze pricing competition between UAM service providers under alternative information structures. Using a Hotelling framework with heterogeneous consumers, we derive Nash equilibrium outcomes for three scenarios: uniform pricing, exclusive pricing and personalized discounting under full information transparency. We characterize the equilibrium prices, profits, and welfare for each scenario and establish analytical conditions under which market segmentation dominates uniform pricing. Our analysis reveals that while segmentation capability increases firm profits, full information sharing among competitors intensifies price competition and improves consumer welfare without substantially reducing firm profitability. We conduct numerical experiments to using Beijing commuting data. The results show that exclusive pricing increases firm profits by 5.12% relative to Bertrand competition but reduces total welfare by 13.2%, whereas moving from constrained to full information transparency increases consumer surplus by 42.4% while reducing firm profits by only 0.11\%. These findings provide theoretical guidance for pricing strategies and information-sharing mechanism design in emerging UAM markets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过博弈论模型分析城市空中交通服务商在不同信息结构下的定价竞争，发现市场细分能提高企业利润，而完全信息共享会加剧价格竞争、提升消费者福利，对企业利润影响有限。
AI.research_question: 城市空中交通服务商在不同信息结构（统一定价、排他定价、个性化折扣）下的定价竞争如何影响企业利润和福利？
AI.motivation: 城市空中交通作为缓解地面交通拥堵的替代方案，需要服务商之间进行信息共享以协调运营，但这种透明度对定价和福利的竞争影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，Hotelling框架（异质性消费者），纳什均衡分析，信息经济学
AI.method: 建立博弈论模型分析三种定价场景：统一定价、排他定价、完全信息透明下的个性化折扣；推导纳什均衡结果；使用北京通勤数据进行数值实验
AI.findings: 1. 排他定价相比伯特兰竞争提高企业利润5.12%，但降低总福利13.2%；2. 从受限信息到完全信息透明使消费者剩余增加42.4%，企业利润仅减少0.11%；3. 市场细分能力提高企业利润，完全信息共享加剧价格竞争但改善消费者福利
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了UAM市场定价竞争的博弈论分析框架；2. 揭示了信息透明度对价格竞争和福利分配的影响机制；3. 为市场细分与统一定价的权衡提供了理论条件
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为UAM服务商提供定价策略指导；2. 为政策制定者设计信息共享机制提供依据；3. 平衡企业利润与消费者福利的实践建议

title: PrivEduWhisper: A Privacy-Preserving Educational Data Management System Using HierarchicalIdentity-Based Encryption
affiliations: , Lecturer, Ton Duc Thang University, FPT University, FPT University, FPT University, FPT University and FPT University

detail.title: PrivEduWhisper: A Privacy-Preserving Educational Data Management System Using HierarchicalIdentity-Based Encryption
detail.abstract: Educational data sharing across institutions faces critical privacy risks, compounded by the need for hierarchical delegation, temporal constraints, and auditability. We introduce PrivEduWhisper, a novel system that synthesizes Hierarchical Identity-Based Encryption (HIBE) with temporal constraints and wildcard delegation patterns while maintaining blockchain-based auditability. Our construction achieves IND-sID-CPA security under the DBDH assumption. Experimental results demonstrate 51–112× speedup over attribute-based encryption schemes, enabling practical deployment in smart education environments.

AI.tldr: PrivEduWhisper是一个结合分层身份加密、时间约束和区块链审计的教育数据共享系统，相比属性加密方案提速51-112倍
AI.research_question: 如何在教育数据跨机构共享中实现隐私保护、分层委托、时间约束和可审计性？
AI.motivation: 教育数据跨机构共享面临严重的隐私风险，同时需要支持分层委托、时间约束和可审计性等复杂需求
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层身份加密（HIBE）、时间约束加密、通配符委托模式、区块链审计技术
AI.method: 提出PrivEduWhisper系统，整合HIBE与时间约束和通配符委托模式，基于DBDH假设实现IND-sID-CPA安全性
AI.findings: 系统相比属性加密方案实现51-112倍加速，能够在智能教育环境中实际部署
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出结合HIBE、时间约束和通配符委托的新型加密方案；2）在DBDH假设下证明IND-sID-CPA安全性
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发出实用的教育数据共享系统；2）显著提升性能，适合智能教育环境部署；3）提供区块链审计功能

title: BIM Library Development: User Requirements, Challenges, and Future Directions
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Georgia Institute of Technology and Georgia Institute of Technology

detail.title: BIM Library Development: User Requirements, Challenges, and Future Directions
detail.abstract: Building information modeling (BIM) libraries serve as digital repositories for building component data used throughout the BIM implementation process. Despite the significant value of these libraries, systematic user requirements and expectations analysis for these repositories are absent. Consequently, despite the availability of several public-domain BIM content libraries, practitioners are struggling with efficient BIM data management in projects. This study employs a mixed-methods approach, including structured literature review, interviews, and a supplementary survey analyzed via fuzzy analytical hierarchy process, to define and clarify BIM library and its components, analyze existing practices and compare them against stakeholder requirements. Key findings demonstrate that the primary values expected of BIM libraries are improved design quality and higher variety of choices in terms of specification-based product selection. Furthermore, maintaining high quality 3D geometries along with accurate scheduling and cost information were determined as essential features required by stakeholders. This study proposes a structured definition of a BIM library, ranks its technical requirements by expected values and information dimensions, and identifies its essential features and attributes, providing a roadmap for developing future BIM libraries and integrating advanced collaborative BIM workflows.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法分析BIM库的用户需求，提出结构化定义、技术需求排序和关键特征，为未来BIM库开发和协作工作流提供路线图。
AI.research_question: BIM库的系统用户需求和期望是什么？如何定义BIM库及其组件，分析现有实践并与利益相关者需求对比？
AI.motivation: 尽管BIM库在BIM实施过程中具有重要价值，但缺乏对这些数字仓库的系统用户需求和期望分析。尽管存在多个公共领域BIM内容库，从业者在项目中仍面临BIM数据管理效率低下的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模糊层次分析法（fuzzy AHP），利益相关者需求分析理论，BIM数据管理理论
AI.method: 混合方法：结构化文献综述、访谈、补充调查，通过模糊层次分析法进行分析
AI.findings: 1. BIM库的主要预期价值是提高设计质量和基于规范的产品选择多样性；2. 高质量3D几何体与准确的进度和成本信息是利益相关者要求的基本特征；3. 提出了BIM库的结构化定义和技术需求排序
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出BIM库的结构化定义；2. 按预期价值和信息维度对技术需求进行排序；3. 识别BIM库的基本特征和属性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为开发未来BIM库提供路线图；2. 为集成先进的协作BIM工作流程提供指导；3. 帮助从业者更有效地管理BIM数据

title: Prediction of Static Voltage Stability Margin Under Wind Power Integration and Load Uncertainty Based on Transformer Neural Network
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Prediction of Static Voltage Stability Margin Under Wind Power Integration and Load Uncertainty Based on Transformer Neural Network
detail.abstract: With the increasing proportion of wind power generation in China's power grid total generation year by year, to address the challenges posed by high-proportion wind power integration and load uncertainty to power system static voltage stability assessment, this paper proposes a surrogate modeling method based on Transformer neural network. To achieve quantitative characterization, we construct a coupled “state index + margin index” evaluation pipeline: Jacobian minimum-modulus eigenvalues support rapid operating-condition screening, and continuation power flow yields the associated static voltage stability margin.The model takes wind speed, load, and generator power as inputs, and adopts a dual-task collaborative optimization architecture of "binary classification (stability discrimination) + regression (margin prediction)". Validation is carried out on the modified IEEE 39-bus system. The results show that the proposed method has high accuracy in stability discrimination and short online evaluation time, and exhibits superior performance in comprehensive accuracy and real-time performance, which can provide an efficient and feasible solution for online assessment of power system static voltage stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Transformer神经网络的代理建模方法，用于解决高比例风电接入和负荷不确定性对电力系统静态电压稳定性评估的挑战。该方法采用"状态指标+裕度指标"耦合评估流程，通过双任务协同优化架构实现稳定性判别和裕度预测，在改进的IEEE 39节点系统上验证了方法的准确性和实时性。
AI.research_question: 如何在高比例风电接入和负荷不确定性的背景下，实现电力系统静态电压稳定性的高效在线评估？
AI.motivation: 随着风电在电网中占比逐年增加，高比例风电接入和负荷不确定性给电力系统静态电压稳定性评估带来了新的挑战，需要开发更高效、准确的在线评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 静态电压稳定性理论；2) Transformer神经网络理论；3) 代理建模方法；4) 双任务协同优化架构（分类+回归）
AI.method: 1) 构建"状态指标+裕度指标"耦合评估流程：雅可比最小模特征值用于快速工况筛选，连续潮流计算静态电压稳定裕度；2) 基于Transformer神经网络的代理建模方法；3) 采用"二元分类（稳定性判别）+回归（裕度预测）"的双任务协同优化架构；4) 在改进的IEEE 39节点系统上进行验证
AI.findings: 1) 所提方法在稳定性判别方面具有高准确性；2) 在线评估时间短；3) 在综合准确性和实时性方面表现出优越性能；4) 能够为电力系统静态电压稳定性在线评估提供高效可行的解决方案
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了基于Transformer神经网络的静态电压稳定性评估代理建模方法；2) 建立了"状态指标+裕度指标"的耦合评估流程；3) 设计了双任务协同优化架构，将稳定性判别和裕度预测有机结合
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为高比例风电接入下的电力系统静态电压稳定性在线评估提供了高效工具；2) 缩短了在线评估时间，提高了评估实时性；3) 为电网运行人员提供了准确、快速的稳定性评估解决方案

title: Blockchain for Collaborative Logistics: Bridging Theory and Practice in Vertical and Horizontal Integration
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and École nationale supérieure d'électricité et de mécanique (ENSEM)

detail.title: Blockchain for Collaborative Logistics: Bridging Theory and Practice in Vertical and Horizontal Integration
detail.abstract: Although blockchain applications in logistics have extensive theoretical support, their effectiveness in addressing interorganizational collaboration challenges remains empirically unverified. To our knowledge, existing studies have not demonstrated functional horizontal collaboration, namely competitor coordination with cryptographic confidentiality, in a fully operational setting. This study implements and documents what we consider the first operational multi-organizational blockchain network enabling both vertical supply chain coordination and horizontal collaboration, with observation-based governance validation conducted through controlled transaction testing. A Hyperledger Fabric network was deployed on Kubernetes using a namespace-based architecture representing a UK distribution system consisting of two factories, four warehouses, and six clients. The implementation proceeded through nine technical phases, from environment setup to network testing, deploying two chaincodes supporting vertical coordination and horizontal coopetition via Private Data Collections (PDC). The network achieved full deployment success across five organizational namespaces and three channels, while resource efficiency was improved in comparison to traditional multi-cluster architectures. Confidentiality protection between competitive partners was maintained and verified through PDC-validated cost and margin protection, and unauthorized transactions were consistently rejected through protocol-enforced endorsement, indicating effective access control enforcement. In addition, complete transaction traceability was maintained across 142 test transactions. Overall, the results confirm that blockchain-enabled multi-organizational logistics collaboration is technically feasible and operationally robust under experimental conditions involving a limited consortium size. The namespace-based deployment pattern provides a replicable framework for academic research and industry pilots, democratizing blockchain experimentation for resource-constrained organizations and advancing understanding of blockchain’s practical viability in multi-organizational logistics contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过部署基于Kubernetes的Hyperledger Fabric区块链网络，验证了多组织物流协作的技术可行性。网络包含2个工厂、4个仓库和6个客户，成功实现了垂直供应链协调和水平竞争协作，通过私有数据集合保护竞争伙伴间的机密信息。
AI.research_question: 区块链技术在多组织物流协作中是否具有技术可行性和操作稳健性？特别是能否同时实现垂直供应链协调和水平竞争协作，并保护竞争伙伴间的机密信息？
AI.motivation: 虽然区块链在物流领域的应用有广泛的理论支持，但其在解决组织间协作挑战方面的有效性缺乏实证验证。现有研究尚未在完全操作环境中展示功能性水平协作（即竞争对手在加密保密下的协调）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链的供应链协调理论、多组织协作框架、竞争（竞争+合作）理论、私有数据集合（PDC）的机密性保护机制。
AI.method: 实验研究方法：部署基于Kubernetes的Hyperledger Fabric区块链网络，采用命名空间架构代表英国分销系统（2个工厂、4个仓库、6个客户）。实施9个技术阶段，部署2个链码支持垂直协调和水平竞争，通过私有数据集合保护机密信息。进行142个测试交易验证。
AI.findings: 1. 网络在5个组织命名空间和3个通道中实现完全部署成功；2. 与传统多集群架构相比资源效率更高；3. 通过PDC验证的成本和利润保护维持了竞争伙伴间的机密性；4. 未经授权的交易通过协议强制背书被一致拒绝；5. 142个测试交易保持完整的交易可追溯性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证验证区块链在多组织物流协作中的技术可行性；2. 展示了垂直协调和水平竞争协作的共存可能性；3. 验证了私有数据集合在保护竞争伙伴机密信息方面的有效性；4. 为区块链在物流领域的实际应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 命名空间部署模式为学术研究和行业试点提供了可复制的框架；2. 使资源受限组织能够进行区块链实验；3. 推进了对区块链在多组织物流环境中实际可行性的理解；4. 为物流行业实施区块链协作提供了技术参考。

title: The impact of TMT turnover on firm growth and the contingency on corporate governance stakeholders
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Alabama in Huntsville, The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics and Nanjing University - School of Business

detail.title: The impact of TMT turnover on firm growth and the contingency on corporate governance stakeholders
detail.abstract: Whether the impact of top management team (TMT) turnover on firm growth is beneficial or detrimental remains inconclusive. To address this gap, this study explores the performance consequence of TMT turnover for firm growth and further examines the contingency of such relationship on the forces of corporate governance: CEO power, dedicated institutional shareholding, and internal succession. Drawing on panel data comprising 18,989 observations from 3,084 Chinese firms during 2010–2020, we find that TMT turnover is negatively associated with firm growth, supporting the seminal view of Penrose’s growth theory, whereas CEO power weakens, dedicated institutional shareholding strengthens, and internal succession mitigates the adverse impact of TMT turnover on firm growth. This research advances the TMT turnover literature by revealing the dark side of TMT turnover for firm growth, and also extends the corporate governance research by showing how different governance mechanisms can shape the growth impact of TMT turnover.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了高管团队(TMT)更替对企业成长的影响，发现TMT更替对企业成长有负面影响，但CEO权力会削弱、专注型机构持股会加强、内部继任会缓解这种负面影响。
AI.research_question: TMT更替对企业成长的影响是积极的还是消极的？公司治理机制（CEO权力、专注型机构持股、内部继任）如何调节这种关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对TMT更替对企业成长的影响存在不一致结论，需要进一步探索其绩效后果及公司治理机制的调节作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Penrose成长理论，认为TMT更替可能破坏组织知识积累和资源整合，从而阻碍企业成长。
AI.method: 使用2010-2020年中国3,084家企业的18,989个观测值的面板数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. TMT更替与企业成长呈负相关；2. CEO权力会削弱这种负面影响；3. 专注型机构持股会加强这种负面影响；4. 内部继任会缓解这种负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了TMT更替对企业成长的"黑暗面"；2. 扩展了公司治理研究，展示了不同治理机制如何塑造TMT更替的成长影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了关于TMT更替决策的实践指导，强调了公司治理机制在调节TMT更替影响中的重要性。

title: Action Space and Inquiry
affiliations: Washington College

detail.title: Action Space and Inquiry
detail.abstract: This article introduces the concept of action space to leadership scholarship — the terrain of possibilities available to leaders within organizational contexts. Unlike managerial discretion, which measures the degree of constraint leaders face, action space describes the actual content of what is possible at the intersection of three organizational forces: bureaucratic rules, cultural norms, and opportunities for initiative. Leaders must develop accurate knowledge of their action space through inquiry, using both formal channels (official briefings, reports, hierarchical information flows) and informal channels (direct observation, back-channel consultations, media monitoring). The alignment between inquiry methods and action methods reveals how leaders position themselves toward organizational constraints. Using presidential leadership as a natural laboratory where constraints are highly visible, this article examines Donald Trump's distinctive approach to mapping action space through an extensive informal phone network that privileges initiative over bureaucratic procedures and cultural norms. The case illustrates how leaders who investigate primarily to protect status and power may develop accurate maps of elite sentiment while maintaining distorted understanding of systemic constraints. The action space framework has important implications for analyzing leadership within bureaucratic contexts — a dimension leadership scholarship has consistently underestimated. The concept reframes debates about transformational leadership, leadership versus management, and leader effectiveness across contexts, while opening research directions in comparative inquiry methods, constraint navigation, and decision-making quality as a function of action space accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文引入"行动空间"概念到领导力研究，描述领导者在组织环境中可用的可能性领域。通过分析特朗普总统的领导案例，展示了领导者如何通过正式和非正式渠道了解行动空间，以及不同调查方法如何影响对组织约束的理解。
AI.research_question: 领导者如何了解和导航其行动空间？不同调查方法如何影响领导者对组织约束的理解？行动空间概念如何重新构建领导力研究？
AI.motivation: 领导力研究长期以来低估了官僚环境中的约束维度。现有研究关注管理自由裁量权（约束程度），但缺乏描述领导者实际可用可能性的概念框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行动空间理论框架：在三种组织力量交汇处定义领导者可能性领域——官僚规则、文化规范和主动机会。强调调查方法与行动方法的对齐，以及领导者对约束的定位。
AI.method: 使用总统领导力作为自然实验室，以特朗普总统为案例研究，分析其通过广泛非正式电话网络映射行动空间的独特方法。
AI.findings: 特朗普通过非正式网络优先考虑主动性而非官僚程序和文化规范。主要为了保护地位和权力进行调查的领导者可能准确了解精英情绪，但对系统性约束保持扭曲理解。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 引入行动空间概念填补领导力研究空白；2. 重新构建变革型领导力、领导与管理区别、跨情境领导有效性等辩论；3. 为比较调查方法、约束导航、决策质量研究开辟新方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助领导者更准确地了解其行动空间，平衡正式和非正式调查渠道，避免对组织约束的扭曲理解，提高决策质量。

title: Asymmetric capacitated transit equilibrium assignment
affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University, Southwest Jiaotong University, The University of Hong Kong, Lancaster University, Northwestern University and Southwest Jiaotong University - School of Transportation and Logistics

detail.title: Asymmetric capacitated transit equilibrium assignment
detail.abstract: Capacity constraints in transit networks are inherently asymmetric.  When vehicles reach capacity, only passengers attempting to board are affected, while those already onboard proceed unimpeded. We identified that conventional models can cause congestion penalties to propagate upstream symmetrically to all passengers traversing saturated segments. This paper formulates the asymmetric capacitated transit equilibrium assignment (AC-TEA) problem as a nonlinear complementarity problem that enforces residual capacity constraints exclusively at boarding links. The complementarity structure ensures multipliers penalize only passengers competing for residual vehicle space.  We develop an efficient method of multipliers and prove its convergence to an accumulation point satisfying the complementarity conditions.  Numerical experiments show that benchmark models produce biased flow predictions that can mislead service planning decisions, whereas the AC-TEA model yields behaviorally consistent predictions aligned with sequential boarding priorities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种非对称容量约束的公交网络均衡分配模型（AC-TEA），该模型仅对试图登车的乘客施加容量约束惩罚，解决了传统模型对称传播拥堵惩罚的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何建立能够准确反映公交网络中容量约束非对称特性的均衡分配模型？
AI.motivation: 公交网络容量约束具有非对称性：当车辆满载时，仅影响试图登车的乘客，而车上乘客不受影响。传统模型会导致拥堵惩罚对称传播给所有经过饱和路段的乘客，产生偏差预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非对称容量约束公交均衡分配（AC-TEA）理论，基于非线性互补问题（NCP）框架，在登车环节实施剩余容量约束。
AI.method: 将AC-TEA问题表述为非线性互补问题，开发高效的乘子法，并证明其收敛到满足互补条件的累积点。
AI.findings: 基准模型会产生有偏的流量预测，可能误导服务规划决策；而AC-TEA模型能产生与顺序登车优先级一致的行为一致性预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次在公交均衡分配中形式化非对称容量约束；2）建立基于互补结构的惩罚机制，确保乘子仅惩罚竞争剩余车辆空间的乘客；3）提供收敛性证明。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为公交服务规划提供更准确的流量预测；2）避免因偏差预测导致的错误规划决策；3）支持基于行为一致性的运营优化。

title: Assessing Readiness for Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture in Coastal Kenya, with Emphasis on Policy, Financial, and Capacity Dimensions
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of East Anglia, Kenya Marine and Fisheries Research Institute, Kenya Marine and Fisheries Research Institute, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Assessing Readiness for Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture in Coastal Kenya, with Emphasis on Policy, Financial, and Capacity Dimensions
detail.abstract: As aquaculture supports food security, Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture (IMTA) helps balance productivity and environmental health. In developing nations, adoption hinges on biological feasibility and institutional readiness. This study assessed stakeholder readiness for IMTA adoption in coastal Kenya across regulatory, financial, and technical dimensions. A cross-sectional survey of 601 stakeholders across five coastal counties (Mombasa, Kilifi, Kwale, Tana River, and Lamu) was conducted. Four domain indices—Regulatory Support (RSI), Financial Accessibility (FAI), Technical Capacity (TCI), and Private-Sector Involvement (PSIS)—were constructed and combined into a composite Adoption Readiness Score (ARS). County variations were analyzed using Kruskal–Wallis tests with Dwass–Steel–Critchlow–Fligner post-hoc comparisons, while multiple linear regression identified predictors of readiness. Results showed moderate readiness (ARS = 0.61 ± 0.12), driven by high regulatory alignment (RSI = 0.82 ± 0.09) and private-sector engagement (PSIS = 0.63 ± 0.22), but constrained by low financial accessibility (FAI = 0.45 ± 0.21) and uneven technical capacity (TCI = 0.54 ± 0.19). Readiness differed across counties (H = 25.96, p < 0.001), with Kwale outperforming Kilifi and Tana River. Extension access (β = 0.090, p < 0.001) and credit availability (β = 0.028, p = 0.047) were positive predictors, while low education and cooperative membership negatively influenced readiness. These findings demonstrates that IMTA adoption in Kenya is not hindered by policy intent but by weak operational capacity, particularly in extension, finance, and knowledge systems, necessitating county-specific financial incentives and participatory capacity-building to realize blue economy goals.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了肯尼亚沿海地区综合多营养水产养殖（IMTA）的采纳准备度，发现整体准备度中等（0.61），主要受监管支持（0.82）和私营部门参与（0.63）驱动，但受限于金融可及性（0.45）和技术能力（0.54）不足。各县准备度存在显著差异，推广服务和信贷可获得性是积极预测因素。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚沿海地区利益相关者对综合多营养水产养殖（IMTA）的采纳准备度如何？哪些因素影响这种准备度？
AI.motivation: 水产养殖支持粮食安全，而IMTA有助于平衡生产力和环境健康。在发展中国家，IMTA的采纳取决于生物可行性和制度准备度。需要评估肯尼亚沿海地区利益相关者的准备度，以促进蓝色经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采纳准备度框架，涵盖监管支持、金融可及性、技术能力和私营部门参与四个维度。使用制度理论和创新采纳理论来分析影响IMTA采纳的因素。
AI.method: 横断面调查设计，对肯尼亚五个沿海县（蒙巴萨、基利菲、夸莱、塔纳河、拉穆）的601名利益相关者进行调查。构建四个领域指数（RSI、FAI、TCI、PSIS）和综合采纳准备度得分（ARS）。使用Kruskal-Wallis检验和Dwass-Steel-Critchlow-Fligner事后比较分析县际差异，使用多元线性回归识别准备度预测因素。
AI.findings: 整体采纳准备度中等（ARS = 0.61 ± 0.12）。监管支持（RSI = 0.82 ± 0.09）和私营部门参与（PSIS = 0.63 ± 0.22）较高，但金融可及性（FAI = 0.45 ± 0.21）和技术能力（TCI = 0.54 ± 0.19）较低。各县准备度存在显著差异（H = 25.96, p < 0.001），夸莱县表现优于基利菲和塔纳河县。推广服务获取（β = 0.090, p < 0.001）和信贷可获得性（β = 0.028, p = 0.047）是积极预测因素，而低教育水平和合作社成员身份对准备度有负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了一个多维度的采纳准备度评估框架，适用于发展中国家水产养殖创新采纳研究。2. 验证了制度准备度（特别是监管和私营部门参与）在创新采纳中的重要性。3. 揭示了金融和技术能力约束对IMTA采纳的关键影响，补充了现有创新采纳理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为肯尼亚政策制定者提供了IMTA采纳准备度的实证证据，指出政策意图不是主要障碍，而是运营能力不足。2. 识别了需要针对性干预的领域：金融激励、推广服务和知识系统建设。3. 提出了县际差异化的实施策略，特别是针对金融可及性和技术能力薄弱的地区。4. 强调了参与式能力建设的重要性，以实现蓝色经济目标。

title: Privacy Regulation and Fintech Lending
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements, Bank for International Settlements (BIS), Einaudi Institute for Economics and Finance, Einaudi Institute for Economics and Finance (EIEF) and European University Institute

detail.title: Privacy Regulation and Fintech Lending
detail.abstract: Consumers dislike sharing data with fintechs, but greater access to data can improve loan market outcomes through better screening. We study how the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), which grants users control over and mitigates concerns about sharing their data, affects fintech lending. After the CCPA's introduction, fintechs' loan rates decline relative to those of other lenders. In addition, rate dispersion across fintech loans increases, fintechs deny more applications, and they make greater use of nontraditional credit scoring models, while their default rates decline by more than those of other lenders. These results are consistent with an improved screening process enabled by additional data. Mortgage originations by fintechs also increase, suggesting that well-designed privacy regulation may enhance financial inclusion.

AI.tldr: 加州消费者隐私法案(CCPA)赋予用户数据控制权，缓解了数据共享担忧，反而使金融科技公司能够获得更多数据，改善贷款筛选过程，降低利率和违约率，同时增加抵押贷款发放，表明设计良好的隐私法规可能促进金融包容性。
AI.research_question: 加州消费者隐私法案(CCPA)如何影响金融科技贷款市场？具体来说，CCPA赋予用户数据控制权并缓解数据共享担忧，这对金融科技公司的贷款利率、贷款审批、风险评估和违约率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 消费者通常不愿意与金融科技公司共享数据，但更多数据访问可以通过更好的筛选改善贷款市场结果。研究旨在理解隐私法规（如CCPA）如何通过改变数据共享动态来影响金融科技贷款市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和隐私经济学理论，探讨数据共享、隐私保护与信贷市场效率之间的关系。CCPA通过缓解消费者对数据滥用的担忧，可能促进数据共享，从而改善金融科技公司的信息获取和风险评估能力。
AI.method: 使用实证研究方法，比较CCPA实施前后金融科技公司与其他贷款机构的贷款表现差异。分析指标包括：贷款利率、利率离散度、贷款申请拒绝率、非传统信用评分模型使用情况、违约率变化以及抵押贷款发放量。
AI.findings: 1. CCPA实施后，金融科技公司的贷款利率相对于其他贷款机构下降；2. 金融科技贷款的利率离散度增加；3. 金融科技公司拒绝更多贷款申请；4. 金融科技公司更多地使用非传统信用评分模型；5. 金融科技公司的违约率下降幅度大于其他贷款机构；6. 金融科技公司的抵押贷款发放量增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了"隐私法规必然限制数据可用性"的传统观点，表明设计良好的隐私法规可能通过缓解消费者担忧而促进数据共享；2. 为隐私保护与信贷市场效率之间的复杂关系提供了新的理论视角；3. 揭示了数据控制权如何改变消费者与金融科技公司之间的信息不对称动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了证据，表明设计良好的隐私法规（如CCPA）可能促进金融包容性；2. 为金融科技公司提供了策略启示：通过尊重消费者隐私和数据控制权，可以获得更多数据并改善风险评估；3. 为消费者提供了启示：隐私保护不一定阻碍获得更好的金融服务。

title: KANs-MobileViT: Enhancing MobileViT with KAN Networks and Multiscale Connections for Parameter-Efficient Image Classification
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: KANs-MobileViT: Enhancing MobileViT with KAN Networks and Multiscale Connections for Parameter-Efficient Image Classification
detail.abstract: To address the challenges of high computational complexity and data dependency in deployingvision transformers on edge devices, the paper proposes KANs-MobileViT, a lightweight and efficient hybridmodel that achieves a balance between low parameter count and high accuracy. For the feature extraction, wedesign a lightweight KAN-MobileViT block, which dynamically integrates spatial and channel features throughlearnable spline functions, effectively encoding both local and global information. In particular, its unique edgelearnable activation function in adjacent layers and efficiently represents parameters. Additionally, the K-SEattention mechanism is proposed to capture nonlinear channel dependencies via Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks(KAN). To enhance information utilization, the ExShortCut connection is introduced to optimize multi-scalefeature propagation and mitigate information loss during downsampling. The synergistic integration of theExShortCut connection and the K-SE modules enables efficient information flow and attention redistribution. Our KANs-MobileViT-XXS/XS/S achieves 70.3%/74.9%/78.7% top-1 accuracy with 2.1 M/3.2 M/6.4Mparameters and 0.3 G/0.7 G/1.3 G FLOPs on ImageNet-1K, outperforming MobileViT-XXS/XS/S with animprovement of +1.3%/+0.2%/+0.3% with 25%/33%/35% reduction in FLOPs. This highlightsits superior performance and broad applicability in image classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KANs-MobileViT，一种轻量高效的混合模型，通过KAN-MobileViT块、K-SE注意力机制和ExShortCut连接，在降低计算复杂度的同时保持高精度，适用于边缘设备部署。
AI.research_question: 如何在边缘设备上部署视觉Transformer，平衡低参数数量和高精度，同时解决高计算复杂度和数据依赖性问题？
AI.motivation: 视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署面临高计算复杂度和数据依赖性的挑战，需要设计轻量高效的模型来平衡参数数量和精度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN)理论，通过可学习样条函数动态整合空间和通道特征，结合注意力机制和多尺度特征传播优化。
AI.method: 设计轻量级KAN-MobileViT块、K-SE注意力机制（通过KAN捕获非线性通道依赖）、ExShortCut连接（优化多尺度特征传播），在ImageNet-1K上进行实验验证。
AI.findings: KANs-MobileViT-XXS/XS/S在ImageNet-1K上分别达到70.3%/74.9%/78.7% top-1准确率，参数为2.1M/3.2M/6.4M，FLOPs为0.3G/0.7G/1.3G，相比MobileViT提升+1.3%/+0.2%/+0.3%准确率，同时减少25%/33%/35% FLOPs。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出基于KAN的轻量级混合模型架构；2) 引入可学习样条函数动态整合特征；3) 设计K-SE注意力机制捕获非线性通道依赖；4) 提出ExShortCut连接优化信息流。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供适用于边缘设备的轻量高效视觉模型；2) 在保持精度的同时显著降低计算复杂度；3) 为图像分类任务提供性能优越的解决方案；4) 模型参数和FLOPs大幅减少，适合资源受限环境。

title: A Robust End-to-End Predict-Then-Optimize Framework for Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Path Flexibility under Urban Traffic Dynamics
affiliations: Macau University of Science and Technology, Macau University of Science and Technology, Jinan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, The University of Hong Kong, Jinan University and Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: A Robust End-to-End Predict-Then-Optimize Framework for Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Path Flexibility under Urban Traffic Dynamics
detail.abstract: With the rapid growth of e-commerce and urban traffic uncertainty, the complex interplay of multi-task coordination and dynamic environments has transformed last-mile delivery into a large-scale, complex dynamic network consisting of vehicles and urban roadways. This results in increasingly severe dispatching challenges arising from the strong coupling between path flexibility and traffic dynamics. Traditional Predict-Then-Optimize approaches struggle with prediction errors and optimization performance, hindering efficient scheduling in urban settings. To address this, we classify urban traffic dynamics into predictable and unpredictable categories. For predictable dynamics, we propose an End-to-End Predict-Then-Optimize Framework for the Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Path Flexibility, integrating an Attention-based Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network for traffic forecasting and a Structured Prediction Objective to align optimization goals with prediction model training. For unpredictable dynamics, we design a modular re-planning mechanism to adapt delivery paths in real-time disruptions, enhancing system stability. A hierarchical reinforcement learning structure is employed to jointly optimize order assignment, vehicle departure times, customer service sequences, and feasible routes selection, enabling the system to accommodate both time-dependent traffic variations and real-time disruptions. To further validate solution quality, we additionally introduce a non-learning heuristic optimization baseline as a benchmark under the two-stage setting. Simulation results show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms conventional Predict-Then-Optimize methods in terms of dispatching cost control, routing robustness, and re-planning efficiency, demonstrating strong practical applicability and potential for real-world deployment in intelligent urban logistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端的预测-优化框架，结合分层强化学习，解决城市最后一公里配送中路径灵活性与交通动态强耦合的调度挑战，显著优于传统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何在城市最后一公里配送中，有效处理可预测和不可预测的交通动态，实现高效的车辆调度和路径规划？
AI.motivation: 电子商务快速增长和城市交通不确定性加剧，使最后一公里配送成为大规模复杂动态网络，传统预测-优化方法因预测误差和优化性能问题难以有效调度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 将城市交通动态分为可预测和不可预测两类；2) 端到端预测-优化框架；3) 分层强化学习结构；4) 模块化重规划机制。
AI.method: 1) 可预测动态：基于注意力机制的时空图卷积网络进行交通预测，结合结构化预测目标对齐优化目标；2) 不可预测动态：模块化重规划机制实时调整路径；3) 分层强化学习联合优化订单分配、车辆出发时间、客户服务序列和可行路径选择；4) 引入非学习启发式优化基准进行验证。
AI.findings: 模拟结果显示，所提方法在调度成本控制、路径鲁棒性和重规划效率方面显著优于传统预测-优化方法，具有强大的实际应用潜力和现实部署价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出端到端预测-优化框架解决时间依赖车辆路径问题；2) 将交通动态分类并分别设计处理机制；3) 建立分层强化学习结构联合优化多个决策维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提高城市物流调度效率；2) 增强系统对实时干扰的适应性；3) 降低配送成本；4) 为智能城市物流提供可部署的解决方案。

title: Principal’s Leadership and Teachers’ Innovation Behaviour: Examining the Effects of Trust, School Climate and Teacher Engagement
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad, Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad and Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad

detail.title: Principal’s Leadership and Teachers’ Innovation Behaviour: Examining the Effects of Trust, School Climate and Teacher Engagement
detail.abstract: Drawing on the Job Demands-Resources (JDR) theory, the present study examines the influence of school leadership on teacher innovative behaviour using a moderated-sequential mediation model. Specifically, we examined the relationships among school leadership, school climate, teacher engagement, trust in the school leader, and teacher innovative behaviour. Data were collected from 1,917 senior secondary school teachers using an online survey. The model was tested using structural equation modelling in Mplus v.8. The results show that school climate and teacher engagement sequentially mediate the relationship between the principal's (referred to as school leadership hereon) transformational leadership and teachers’ innovative behaviour. Additionally, the study shows that the indirect effect of school leadership on teachers’ innovative behaviour, via school climate and teacher engagement, is conditional on trust in the school principal. The findings have significant implications for improving teacher innovative behaviour and designing training programs for school leaders. Implications for research and practice are discussed.

AI.tldr: 基于工作要求-资源理论，本研究通过调节序列中介模型探讨学校领导力对教师创新行为的影响。研究发现学校氛围和教师投入在校长变革型领导力与教师创新行为之间起序列中介作用，且该间接效应受对校长的信任调节。
AI.research_question: 学校领导力如何通过学校氛围和教师投入影响教师创新行为？对校长的信任在这一过程中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 教师创新行为对教育质量提升至关重要，但学校领导力如何影响教师创新行为的机制尚不明确。需要理解领导力通过哪些中介路径影响创新，以及信任如何调节这些关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作要求-资源理论，重点关注变革型领导力、学校氛围、教师投入、信任和教师创新行为之间的关系框架。
AI.method: 采用在线问卷调查收集1917名高中教师数据，使用Mplus v.8进行结构方程模型分析，检验调节序列中介模型。
AI.findings: 1. 学校氛围和教师投入在校长变革型领导力与教师创新行为之间起序列中介作用；2. 这一间接效应受对校长的信任调节，即信任水平影响中介路径的强度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将JDR理论应用于教育领导力研究；2. 提出并验证了学校领导力影响教师创新行为的序列中介机制；3. 揭示了信任在领导力-创新关系中的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为提升教师创新行为提供具体路径：通过改善学校氛围和促进教师投入；2. 为校长培训项目设计提供依据，强调建立信任的重要性；3. 为学校管理实践提供实证指导。

title: Environmental disclosure as strategic action: Business strategy and external sensemaking under uncertainty
affiliations: University of Verona

detail.title: Environmental disclosure as strategic action: Business strategy and external sensemaking under uncertainty
detail.abstract: Firms increasingly operate under conditions of compounded uncertainty, as strategic decisions and their external interpretations unfold simultaneously. Climate change intensifies this challenge by introducing long time horizons, ambiguous payoffs, and heightened scrutiny, particularly for environmentally exposed firms. Although environmental disclosure is commonly framed as a transparency mechanism to reduce information asymmetries, its strategic role under uncertainty remains poorly understood. This study reconceptualizes environmental disclosure as a form of strategic action through which firms manage external sensemaking, rather than merely disclosing information. We argue that the effects of environmental disclosure depend critically on firms’ business strategies, understood as postures toward risk-taking, discretion, and opportunity pursuit. Using a panel of European listed firms from 2012 to 2022, we examine how environmental disclosure interacts with environmental risk and business strategy to shape external interpretations of firm prospects. The results reveal systematic heterogeneity. Among environmentally risky firms with stable, efficiency-oriented strategies, environmental disclosure is associated with reduced uncertainty. By contrast, firms with high environmental exposure and aggressive, opportunity-seeking strategies experience interpretive ambiguity following disclosure. Overall, environmental disclosure emerges as a strategic response to uncertainty that, under certain conditions, supports strategic greenhushing by preserving managerial discretion.

AI.tldr: 环境披露不是简单的信息透明机制，而是企业在复合不确定性下的战略行动，用于管理外部意义建构。其效果取决于企业战略类型：稳定效率型战略的企业通过披露降低不确定性，而激进机会型战略的企业则面临解释模糊性。
AI.research_question: 环境披露如何作为战略行动，与企业环境风险和业务战略相互作用，塑造外部对企业前景的解读？
AI.motivation: 企业在复合不确定性下运营，气候变化加剧了这一挑战。虽然环境披露常被视为减少信息不对称的透明机制，但其在不确定性下的战略作用尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略行动理论、意义建构理论、不确定性管理理论、企业战略分类（风险承担、自主权、机会追求）
AI.method: 使用2012-2022年欧洲上市公司面板数据，分析环境披露、环境风险和企业战略如何相互作用影响外部对企业前景的解读。
AI.findings: 存在系统性异质性：环境风险高且采用稳定效率型战略的企业，环境披露与不确定性降低相关；而环境暴露高且采用激进机会型战略的企业，披露后出现解释模糊性。环境披露成为支持战略性"绿色沉默"的战略响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新概念化环境披露为战略行动而非信息透明机制；提出环境披露效果取决于企业战略类型的理论框架；扩展了不确定性条件下战略沟通的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业理解环境披露的战略作用；指导企业根据自身战略类型和环境风险调整披露策略；揭示战略性"绿色沉默"的管理自主权保护机制。

title: Balanced scorecard practice revisited: How digitalization is shaping contemporary performance measurement
affiliations: University of Vaasa, University of Vaasa, accounting and finance and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Balanced scorecard practice revisited: How digitalization is shaping contemporary performance measurement
detail.abstract: This study investigates how large Finnish companies currently apply and interpret the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) and how its role has developed in a context characterized by digitalization, expanded strategic priorities and evolving performance management infrastructures. The BSC has long been viewed as a central strategic performance measurement system, yet prior research shows substantial variation in how organizations understand and implement it. This variation raises questions about whether core principles such as causal reasoning, strategic alignment and balanced measurement still guide practice. At the same time, advances in business intelligence (BI), data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) have reshaped how performance information is produced and used, while sustainability and stakeholder-related goals increasingly influence organizational strategies. Despite these developments, limited empirical research examines how the BSC functions within digitally enabled environments. To address this gap, the study revisits and extends Malmi’s (2001) work by exploring BSC use in 20 large Finnish organizations across diverse industries. Using an exploratory qualitative design and drawing on semi-structured interviews with senior managers, controllers and strategy professionals, the study examines whether the BSC remains in use, how digitalization and analytics shape its form and function and the extent to which its theoretical foundations continue to influence practice. The findings show that explicit references to the BSC have decreased, but its underlying logic remains embedded in organizational routines and in technologically integrated performance systems. However, systematic causal modeling and advanced analytics are applied unevenly, suggesting unrealized opportunities for data-driven strategic control. The study contributes to management accounting research by clarifying how established control frameworks adapt to data-rich environments and by providing updated empirical insight into the contemporary evolution of the BSC.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了在数字化、战略优先级扩展和绩效管理基础设施演变的背景下，芬兰大型企业如何应用和解读平衡计分卡（BSC），以及其角色如何发展。研究发现BSC的明确引用减少，但其底层逻辑仍嵌入组织惯例和技术集成系统中。
AI.research_question: 在数字化、战略优先级扩展和绩效管理基础设施演变的背景下，芬兰大型企业如何应用和解读平衡计分卡？其角色如何发展？BSC的核心原则是否仍然指导实践？
AI.motivation: BSC长期被视为核心战略绩效测量系统，但先前研究显示组织对其理解和实施存在显著差异。同时，商业智能、数据分析和人工智能的发展重塑了绩效信息的产生和使用方式，可持续性和利益相关者相关目标日益影响组织战略。然而，有限的经验研究探讨BSC在数字化环境中的功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Malmi（2001）关于BSC应用的研究框架，并扩展到数字化和数据分析背景下的战略绩效管理系统理论。
AI.method: 采用探索性定性研究设计，基于对20家芬兰大型企业的高级管理者、控制者和战略专业人员的半结构化访谈。
AI.findings: BSC的明确引用减少，但其底层逻辑仍嵌入组织惯例和技术集成绩效系统中。系统性的因果建模和高级分析应用不均衡，表明数据驱动战略控制存在未实现的机遇。
AI.theory_contributions: 为管理会计研究做出贡献，阐明了已建立的控制框架如何适应数据丰富的环境，并提供了关于BSC当代演变的更新实证见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了组织在数字化环境中如何调整绩效管理系统，指出了系统性因果建模和高级分析应用不均衡的问题，为企业优化数据驱动战略控制提供了实践启示。

title: Orienteering and exploration over a spatial heatmap
affiliations: James Cook University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, James Cook University, James Cook University and James Cook University

detail.title: Orienteering and exploration over a spatial heatmap
detail.abstract: The Orienteering Problem involves routing to points of interest within a certain distance ortime constraint in order to maximize the reward of visits. Traditionally, orienteering prob-lems have discrete points of interest in a weighted graph. However, in cases of exploration,particular geographic areas become “areas of interest”, creating a heatmap of potential value.When discretised into a grid, required visits mixed with optional areas to visit create verylarge-scale orienteering problems. These large problems are not easily amenable to solutionusing traditional orienteering problem methods, and so development of methodologies thatstrategically incorporate heatmap information in an orienteering context is an ongoing chal-lenge in research. This paper frames the problem as an arc orienteering problem variant,and proposes a multi-step solution approach that allows for parallelisation and fast re-solve.We decompose the problem into path-finding and distance constraint satisfaction aspects.We propose two pathfinding algorithms that use the heatmap to provide high-value pathcandidates. We then formulate a Set Partitioning method to select a set of paths meet-ing distance constraints. Testing instances based on a real-world application demonstratesthe effectiveness of our method compared to direct conversion into a classic orienteeringproblem. Abstracting the heatmap graph into arc paths reduces problem complexity, anddemonstrates a useful technique for large-scale exploration contexts. Our methodology maybe used broadly when route planning through known points of interest, while simultaneouslyexploring potential areas of interest. Such applications arise in emergency disaster response,conservation management, infrastructure monitoring, and geospatial surveying.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种处理大规模热图导向问题的多步解法，将问题分解为路径寻找和距离约束满足两部分，通过并行化和快速重解提高效率。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决大规模热图导向问题，即在包含必访点和可选兴趣区域的热图网格中，在距离约束下最大化访问奖励？
AI.motivation: 传统定向问题处理离散兴趣点，但在探索场景中，兴趣区域形成热图，离散化为网格后产生大规模问题，传统方法难以有效解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 弧定向问题变体，将热图信息战略性地整合到定向问题框架中。
AI.method: 多步解法：1) 将问题分解为路径寻找和距离约束满足；2) 提出两种利用热图生成高价值路径候选的算法；3) 使用集合划分方法选择满足距离约束的路径集合。
AI.findings: 相比直接转换为经典定向问题，该方法在基于真实应用的测试实例中表现更有效；将热图抽象为弧路径降低了问题复杂度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了处理大规模热图导向问题的新框架，将热图信息战略性地整合到定向问题中，为大规模探索场景提供了有用的技术。
AI.practical_contributions: 方法可广泛应用于已知兴趣点路线规划同时探索潜在兴趣区域的场景，如应急灾害响应、保护管理、基础设施监测和地理空间调查。

title: A Feature-rich Offshore Supply Vessel Routing and Scheduling Problem in the Oil and Gas Industry
affiliations: Curtin University, Curtin University, Curtin University and Loyola University of Chicago

detail.title: A Feature-rich Offshore Supply Vessel Routing and Scheduling Problem in the Oil and Gas Industry
detail.abstract: This paper addresses a routing and scheduling problem for supply vessels that service multiple offshore facilities from a central base. The problem incorporates various operational requirements, such as the use of a heterogeneous fleet, split deliveries, multiple visits to each facility, time windows with allowed service interruptions due to facility closing hours, and berth capacity. The aim is to prepare a 7-day schedule for each vessel that will be repeated each week to minimise the total operational cost and fixed cost of chartering vessels. We formulate the problem as a mixed-integer programming (MILP) model that determines  fleet composition,  vessel routing,  service timing,  and delivery quantities.  Building on this MILP, we propose a matheuristic based on a multi-start iterated local search framework. The heuristic explores neighbourhoods associated with fleet composition and routing decisions.  For a given fleet composition and routing decision, a simplified formulation is derived by fixing the corresponding fleet composition and routing decisions in MILP. The simplified formulation is solved for optimal timing and quantity decisions. We also introduce a benchmark dataset constructed using the operational data of a leading Australian oil and gas company. Computational experiments show that the proposed heuristic effectively produces high‑quality solutions for these benchmark instances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究为多个海上设施提供服务的供应船的路径规划与调度问题，考虑异构船队、分批交付、多次访问、时间窗口、设施关闭时间、泊位容量等约束，目标是制定每周重复的7天调度计划以最小化总运营成本和租船固定成本。
AI.research_question: 如何为服务多个海上设施的供应船设计高效的路由和调度方案，在满足异构船队、分批交付、多次访问、时间窗口、设施关闭时间、泊位容量等复杂约束下，最小化总运营成本和租船固定成本？
AI.motivation: 海上油气行业需要定期向多个海上设施供应物资，但现有调度方法难以处理复杂的实际约束，如异构船队、分批交付、设施关闭时间等，导致运营成本高昂，需要更高效的优化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于混合整数规划（MILP）的车辆路径问题扩展框架，结合多起点迭代局部搜索的数学启发式算法，将问题分解为船队组成、路径规划、服务时间和交付数量四个决策维度。
AI.method: 1）建立包含船队组成、路径规划、服务时间和交付数量的MILP模型；2）提出基于多起点迭代局部搜索的数学启发式算法，探索船队组成和路径决策的邻域；3）对给定船队组成和路径决策，通过固定相应变量简化MILP模型，优化时间和数量决策；4）使用澳大利亚油气公司的运营数据构建基准数据集进行验证。
AI.findings: 提出的数学启发式算法能够为基准实例有效生成高质量解决方案，验证了方法在实际运营场景中的有效性和实用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了车辆路径问题理论，纳入异构船队、分批交付、多次访问、时间窗口中断、泊位容量等复杂约束；2）提出了结合MILP和局部搜索的数学启发式框架；3）建立了海上供应船调度问题的基准数据集。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为海上油气公司提供了实用的调度优化工具；2）能够显著降低运营成本和租船成本；3）支持制定每周重复的7天调度计划，提高运营效率；4）基于真实运营数据验证了方法的实用性。
